scientific_checks.evaluator_grouping_integrity: Enforces GroupKFold grouped by evaluator_id (N=60 clinical experts across 600 interactions) to prevent individual evaluator scoring bias from leaking between training and validation partitions.
scientific_checks.auxiliary_dialogue_scope: Evaluates candidate generated response strings before Carl voices them. Does NOT claim to predict whether a patient needs assistance; it strictly scores the clinical clarity and empathy of the explanation text itself.
